Amul Ice Cream a way to Incredible India

Amul Ice Cream is a trusted brand launched by Amul. Amul sugar free probiotic ice cream is for those people who are sugar conscious and would want to control their weight while enjoying having an ice cream. This ice cream won the international diary marketing federation award in the year 2007. So if you find a Amul ice cream parlor do pay a visit and give a treat to your taste buds.

-> Newyorkers: This is a part of their "TIB Mashups" . So what exactly is a mashup you may ask . It is basically cakes mashed up with their ice cream base. Newyorkers is a cheesecake mashup. -> Dark Night Sundae : first of all this dish had a presentation that was just next level awesome . The taste is a heavenly ride. The dark chocolate was well combined with the other elements of this dish .
